definitions.title: Derivative Rule for Inverses
definitions.statement: If f is one-to-one and differentiable with non-zero derivative at a, then its inverse f^(-1) is differentiable at b = f(a) and its slope is the reciprocal of the slope of f at a.
definitions.explanation: Reflecting a tangent line across the line y = x inverts its slope (Delta y / Delta x becomes Delta x / Delta y).
definitions.keyTakeaway: The derivative of the inverse function is the reciprocal of the derivative of the original function.
